newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Bank Negara Malaysia adds three principal dealers.
newsitem.headline: Bank Negara Malaysia adds three principal dealers.

text.p: Bank Negara Malaysia will add three more financial institutions to its list of principal dealers from the beginning of 1997, the central bank's Governor Ahmad Mohd Don announced.

Bank of Commerce, Hongkong Bank Malaysia Bhd and Commerce International Merchant Bankers Bhd (CIMB) will join 13 existing principal dealers of the central bank, the governor announced at the Forex Association of Malaysia annual dinner on Saturday.
"There will be three more principal dealers" to help improve the efficiency of the banking system, the governor said.
Bank Negara had cut the number of principal dealers from 23 to 13 at the beginning of this year, comprising seven commercial banks, three merchant banks and three discount houses.
The principal dealers are financial institutions appointed to help promote the growth of local bond market.
They are usually large in size and are obliged to provide two-way quotes on bond issues of the government as specified by Bank Negara.
Bank of Commerce and CIMB are both part of the Commerce Asset-Holding Bhd group, while Hongkong Bank is a wholly-owned subsidiary of HSBC Holdings Plc.
